lines.en: I walk step by step. Slowly.
This husk on me dried out long ago.
My steps drag on the ground.
Light does not bother me; the husk shields it.

lines.zh: 壳上有刻痕，是以前记的路。
lines.en: Notches on my husk mark the old roads.

lines.zh: 我记得的，可能不是真的。
lines.en: What I remember may not be true.
I go round the roots, keep to the road.
I come out in daylight too.

lines.zh: 太阳照在我身上，我不觉得热。
lines.en: Sun on me. I don't feel heat.

lines.zh: 我拖着一条腿，走了很远。
lines.en: I drag one leg. I've come a long way.
There's a village ahead.

lines.zh: 我踩过枯枝，壳里沙沙响。
lines.en: I step on dead branches; my husk rustles.
I stand. Wind whistles through the cracks.
There's nothing left inside.
I lift a hand. The joint sticks.

lines.zh: 我记得有人叫过我的名字。
lines.en: I remember someone calling my name.
Can't recall what it was.
This husk will keep walking.
I don't know how long I've walked.
I stand still; wind turns inside my husk.
There's no one else on the road.
I lower my head slowly.
I stop and wait for you to pass first.

lines.zh: 从深渊来的我，只有十点命。
lines.en: From the abyss, with ten points.
You carry warmth.
I haven't had that in a long time.
Are you going to pass?
If you're passing, step aside.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，是想让你看清。
lines.en: I raise a hand so you can see clearly.
This husk is still hard.
You stepped back. I needn't stop.
That's simplest.
Dry wind leaks from the crack.

lines.zh: 里面空空的，没什么可伤。
lines.en: It's hollow. Nothing there to hurt.
An echo rings in my hollow husk; I straighten.
This hollow husk was slow already.
I brace on a tree and pause.
I'll keep walking anyway.
This husk was never whole.

lines.zh: 壳裂了一道，我还站得住。
lines.en: The shell cracked, but I still stand.
I feel nothing.
I must walk on.
I don't live by eating.
It's hollow inside. Nothing goes in.

lines.zh: 你举着食物，我的壳一动不动。
lines.en: You hold up food; my husk stays still.

lines.zh: 这个味道，像很久以前的饭。
lines.en: This smell is like a meal from long ago.
A very long time ago.
Leave it. I won't take it.

lines.zh: 我伸出干枯的手，又缩回壳里。
lines.en: I reach out a withered hand, then pull it into my husk.
My fingers are stiff. Can't hold it.

lines.zh: 我没有嘴，吃东西是浪费。
lines.en: I have no mouth; food is wasted on me.
I lower my hand and walk on.
Dry skin on bone — no sound when struck.

lines.zh: 我这层干壳，是走久了结的。
lines.en: This dried husk formed from long walking.

lines.zh: 壳撞出闷响，里面是空的。
lines.en: My husk thuds; it is hollow inside.
I brace on the wall and straighten slowly.
Your foot is on mine.
It doesn't hurt. I just can't move.

lines.zh: 干瘪的肩，被你顶得挪了半寸。
lines.en: Your shove moved my sunken shoulder half an inch.
Clear a little of the road.
This road. I need to pass.
Don't stand in the middle of the road.
There's none of that in me.

lines.zh: 里面是空的，你也看见了。
lines.en: It's hollow inside. You can see.

lines.zh: 壳里的我，只想找个人一起走。
lines.en: Inside this husk, I only want someone to walk with.
Walk with me a while.
Walk a stretch. No need to talk.
This road is too long alone.
Walk slower. I can't keep up.
My legs are slow. I'll take my time.
We'll get there before dark.
Perhaps I'll get there. Perhaps.
I bend. The husk creaks.

lines.zh: 我弯腰去捡，壳响了一声。
lines.en: I bend to pick it up and my shell creaks.
I've looked. It isn't mine.
I pick it up, then drop it again.
I remember this.
Long ago it was common.
I carried it a while.
Then I forgot what for.
Couldn't recall a use. So I set it down.
Set it down. Walk on.

lines.zh: 主世界的风，吹得壳发响。
lines.en: Overworld wind rattles my husk.
I turn that way, slowly.
Not much can see from these cracks.
But I know the direction.
No need to rush. I'll walk over.

lines.zh: 空壳不会累，我会一直走。
lines.en: An empty husk never tires; I keep walking.
But I don't stop.
If you're going to run, run.
I'll get there.
I've always got there. Always.
Easy. One step at a time.

lines.zh: 我等了很久，不在乎再等。
lines.en: I've waited long. More waiting is nothing.

lines.zh: 我这层壳早干了，脚步拖在地上。
lines.en: This shell of mine dried long ago; my steps drag.
Hear my steps. Very slow.
But always nearer.
Come to this step.

lines.zh: 我跟在你后面，脚步和你一样。
lines.en: I follow behind, matching your steps.

lines.zh: 你回头，我还在那个距离。
lines.en: Look back. I'm at the same distance.

lines.zh: 我一直这个速度，不加速。
lines.en: I keep this pace. I don't speed up.
To catch you, I needn't speed up.
When you tire, you'll stop.
I'll still be walking then.

lines.zh: 这一路的土，都是我的脚印。
lines.en: The whole road bears my prints.
I've walked it back and forth many times.
You're on this road too.
So we're travelling together.
Only you're ahead.
And I'm behind.
And on like this.
Until you stop.
You stopped. So do I.
Only that once.

lines.zh: 我的壳早就空了，还在走。
lines.en: My shell emptied long ago; I still walk.
I'm still on this rhythm.
This rhythm won't change.
It won't change. Nor quicken.
I raise a hand. Slowly.
It comes down a little less slowly.
The husk's edge is thinner than it looks.
The husk's edge is thin. And sharp.

lines.zh: 我的干指扣进你的皮甲。
lines.en: My withered fingers dig into your leather.
My fingers won't close. They hook.
This isn't hatred.
I forgot how to hate long ago.
Only my hands remember.
Don't move. It'll be quicker.
I used to treat people this way too.
The old days. Can't recall clearly.
Then let it end here.
I press down slowly.
I press down. The husk creaks.
This sound. You hear it.
So do I.
A familiar sound.
Like this. It's done.
I leave you and walk on ahead.
I come from the far end of the road.
A layer of dust on this husk.
Sun on me. I keep walking.
I remember houses here.
Not anymore.
I stop and look a while.
A look, then I go on.
There are fresh prints on the road.

lines.zh: 不是我这双鞋踩出来的。
lines.en: Not made by these boots.
Fresh prints. I follow them.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，空壳拖在地上。
lines.en: I walk slowly; this husk drags along.
Slow, but always walking.
Fire makes the husk brittle.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，壳碎了几片。
lines.en: I rolled down the slope and broke some plates.

lines.zh: 空壳灌满水，一直往下沉。
lines.en: A hollow husk fills with water and sinks.
The blast put me flat on the ground.

lines.zh: 有东西穿过壳，钉在后面。
lines.en: Something went through the husk and stuck behind.

lines.zh: 那光一照，我听见了很远的声。
lines.en: That light let me hear a sound from very far.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，壳在风里变轻。
lines.en: I don't eat. The husk grows lighter in the wind.
Lightning struck and I went rigid.
There's no path to walk.
